4958.title: Codex drops disabled reasoning before session startup
4958.rootCauseOneLine: The Codex provider excludes none from its custom-model effort ladder and maps the existing none level to null, causing session configuration to throw.
4958.proposedFix: Advertise none in the existing Codex capability ladder and option descriptors, and pass it through the session effort mapping; preserve the medium default and ultracode rejection.
4958.caveats: Reproduced at the real bb configuration and custom-model boundaries, not through a live Codex endpoint. Endpoint and model support remain model-dependent. The same agent repeated both failures in a second clean checkout.
